title: Accessing MYP Physics eAssessment Results
summary: Learn how to access MYP Physics eAssessment results, when they are released, why your school coordinator matters, and what to do if there is a problem.
body_markdown:
If you took an **MYP Physics eAssessment** , you normally receive your result through your school’s **MYP coordinator** , not through the Diploma Programme candidate website. The IB releases MYP results to schools, and each school decides how and when students receive them. Contact your coordinator or school office if you have not received instructions.


This guide explains the release dates, access process, meaning of your Physics grade, and steps to take if a result is delayed or appears incorrect.


### Who provides your MYP Physics result?


MYP eAssessment results are administered through the school. Students and legal guardians generally communicate with the IB through the school’s **MYP coordinator** , rather than contacting the IB directly about an individual result.


There is no standard MYP equivalent of the DP candidate results website. Instructions involving a personal code and PIN usually concern **DP or CP results** , so those credentials will not normally provide access to an MYP Physics result.


Your school may distribute results through:


- A printed results statement
- A secure student portal
- An email or coordinator meeting
- A school office collection process
- Documentation showing subject grades and an MYP Certificate outcome


Ask your coordinator which method applies. Schools may need time after the official release to check and distribute results.


### When are MYP Physics results released?


The IB’s published MYP assessment timeline states that results are issued from **12:00 noon GMT on 1 August** for the May examination session and **12:00 noon GMT on 1 February** for the November session. These are release times for schools, not guaranteed student notification times.


After a May assessment, your school should normally be able to access the result from 1 August. Distribution may occur later because of holidays or school procedures.


Your result should show a Physics grade on the MYP **1-7 scale** . It may also contribute to your overall MYP Certificate if you completed the required certificate assessments.


### How to access your result


1. **Confirm your session.** Check whether you took the May or November session and were registered for MYP Physics.
2. **Review school communications.** Check your school email, learning platform, student portal, and MYP announcements.
3. **Contact the coordinator.** Ask when and how results will be distributed.
4. **Verify your details.** Check your name, candidate information, subject, session, and grade.
5. **Request an official copy if required.** Ask what document can be provided to another school or institution.
6. **Store the result securely.** Save an electronic copy and retain any official paper document.


Do not rely on an unofficial screenshot as proof of your grade. Your coordinator can explain the approved process for sending results elsewhere.


### What does the Physics grade mean?


MYP Physics belongs to the MYP sciences assessment group. Its externally assessed on-screen examination tests scientific knowledge, understanding, application, analysis, and communication, including work with unfamiliar contexts.


The final subject grade is reported from **1 to 7** and is separate from your school’s internal Physics mark. Classroom reports may incorporate tests, practical work, projects, and teacher assessments, so the two grades do not have to match.


For the full MYP Certificate, Physics may form part of the certificate requirements. The maximum certificate total is **56 points** , based on eight required eAssessments graded from 1 to 7. Certificate eligibility also depends on the applicable minimum total and grade conditions, which your coordinator can explain using your complete results.


### What can the MYP coordinator do?


Your coordinator can clarify:


- Your official examination session and release date
- The school’s results distribution method
- Which results documents you will receive
- The procedure and deadline for an enquiry upon results


Under MYP assessment procedures, an enquiry upon results must be submitted by the school on the candidate’s behalf. The coordinator can explain available review or re-mark options, deadlines, fees, and consent requirements.


A re-mark is not risk-free. The grade from an on-screen examination may increase or decrease, so the school must obtain the required written consent before proceeding.


### What if you cannot access your result?


Confirm that the release date has passed and check whether your school announced a particular distribution method. A result may not appear online if the school uses email, appointments, or printed documents.


If other students have received results but you have not, contact the coordinator with your full name, MYP year, examination session, and subject. Never send passwords through an unsecured channel.


If your name, subject, or grade appears incorrect, ask the coordinator to check the school’s IB records. The school must handle any formal correction or enquiry.


### Using the result to improve


Compare your result with teacher feedback and identify whether your main difficulty involved scientific knowledge, data interpretation, equations, written reasoning, or on-screen time management.


RevisionDojo’s[MYP Physics resources](https://www.revisiondojo.com/myp/myp-physics) and[MYP Physics Question Bank](https://www.revisiondojo.com/myp/myp-physics/questionbank) support focused practice with command terms, calculations, data analysis, and unfamiliar applications. Use them alongside current school and IB guidance.


### Conclusion


To access your MYP Physics eAssessment result, contact your school’s MYP coordinator and follow its distribution process. Results are normally issued to schools on 1 August for May sessions and 1 February for November sessions. Check your official document carefully and ask the coordinator about certificate calculations or an enquiry upon results when necessary. RevisionDojo’s MYP Physics resources and Question Bank can then help you address specific weaknesses.
